topic: What time does the last Tube leave Brixton on a Saturday night?

text: Does anyone know what time the last tube leaves brixton on a sat night
Victoria line night tube on sat I think?? So no last train as such. But I'd check tfl
Oh right yeah. Night tube is a bit random tho innit
Mostly fine. Not sure about the gap after 1am when it's packed
Night Tube runs on the Victoria line Fri and Sat nights. I'd still check the TfL status page the morning of.
Nights all week so saturday is my only sleep in. Ok where are we meeting, forum or pre drinks
Pre drinks at the one by brixton station?? It's opening late sat
The one with the ramp. Dont know the name
Forum is fine. Doors 7 I think.
Doors 7 so pre drinks 5ish? I can do 5
5 works. I finish at 4 so I'll be knackered lol
Is kentish town direct from brixton or do I need to change
Change at euston I think then northern line. Or stockwell? Not sure
Ok. I'll check the maps thing nearer the time
